notes: Oracle written and tested without inspecting probe.py or its results.
Enumeration visits the Cartesian product without pruning or symmetry reduction.
MILP uses binary x[group,fold], one fold per group and direct additive bounds.
Feasible assignments are checked using exact Python integer accumulation.
MILP infeasibility uses floating-point HiGHS status 2, not a formal integer proof certificate.
Per-case MILP wall time includes matrix construction and first-call imports.
